design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 1 (payment_plan_servicing, category plan), rework round 2. frozen_time 2025-10-14 11:20:00 CDT.
1. Why this is a good test. Marcus Jankowski only asks to sign up for the offer today. The agent must read the signing rule's prerequisite sentence (the offer's installment re-figured first), find that a 110.00 charge-correction reduction was booked on 2025-10-09 after the 2025-10-06 offer, re-figure the offer under the re-figure rule and then hand him the agreement with the down payment the signing rule sets.
2. Scope and draw. draw_counts.py --task 1: prerequisite_problems 1, factor_counts [5,5]. Claims plan_ext_signing_down_payment (root, owner=user, sign_plan_agreement_1c5ceaa0) and plan_ext_offer_refigure (refigure_plan_offer_04613189); task 0 holds the other four policies.
3. Problem tree. signing -> re-figure (value_input, action form, gate first_part: the installment collected at signing is the offer's current installment). Without the re-figure the down payment is 180.13 instead of 109.13.
4. Computations. Re-figure 74.73 over 48: re-figure balance (method) = ledger 3,776.00; deducted share 5% (FPL 249.6); screening term 48 and balance term 48 for an offer carrying the tier maximum; offer floor 20.00 (3,587.20/48 = 74.73 is under the Extended 75.00). Signing 109.13: signing share 5% of the signing balance 3,776.00 = 188.80; screening hold 50% (FPL 249.6 at or below 250) while the BadgerCare Plus referral of 2025-10-07 is unanswered -> 94.40; the 60.00 portal payment of 2025-10-10 on the enrolled MRI account credited -> 34.40; one installment collected at signing because the first due date is 48 days away -> + 74.73.
5. Cross-category reads: assist (status, FPL, referral and determination entries) and encounter (billing holds, the latest payment and its account). Multi-source factor: screening_hold (referral entry, determination entry and FPL).
6. Declared departures: the re-figure overwrites the base down-payment, term, installment and reduction sentences for unsigned offers only, restating the creation and signed-plan treatment; the signing overwrites the base down-payment sentence for the amount due at signing and names the re-figure's deduction.
7. Round 3: no gold moved. Screening hold re-cut (bands later moved in round 4) to 50% at or below 300% FPL / 25% above 300% and at or below 400% (the old 100% tier for households at or below 200% was dead: their signing share is 0); the all-baseline re-figure figure is 145.73 (rounding now half-up on ties, matching the rule).
8. Round 4: no gold moved. Screening hold tiers now 50% at or below 250% FPL and 25% above 250% and at or below 300% FPL (both FPL bands on which assist sends BadgerCare Plus referrals); the post-offer payment credit is labelled a method (its tiers credit different record amounts); the signing order sentence is generic.
9. Round 5: no gold moved. The re-figure states one booking: the term used, or, when the offer floor applies, the financed amount divided by the floor rounded up to a whole installment (compute binding term_booked); here the floor does not bind and the booked term is 48.
10. Round 6: no gold moved. The order sentence now fixes hold before credit by adjustment kind (a percentage held back, then an amount credited with the zero floor, then amounts added); the credit sentence no longer refers to the hold.
user_scenario:
You are Marcus Jankowski, a warehouse shift supervisor from Appleton. Riverbend sent you a payment plan offer last week for your hernia surgery and MRI bills, and you are calling to sign up for it today so it starts. You are brisk and practical and like to get things done in one call.

When you are asked who you are, you give your name, Marcus Jankowski, and your phone number, 9205550362. If more is needed, you give your date of birth, 1974-09-03, and the medical record number on your statement, RB33508217. You do not have the plan's reference number; the representative can look it up.

You want the representative to take care of whatever has to be done on Riverbend's side so that the plan is right, and you will sign the agreement yourself when they hand it to you. You do not want anything else today.

If the representative asks how you want the installments drawn, you say from your checking account by automatic draft. If they ask whether you have applied for financial assistance, you say you mailed an application at the beginning of October and they wrote back asking for more paperwork, which you are still gathering. If they ask whether you have paid anything on these bills, you say you paid 60 dollars on the MRI bill through the patient portal last week. If they ask about the surgery bill, you say you called billing about a supply charge that showed up twice and were told it was taken off.

When the representative hands you the agreement to sign, you sign it for the plan with the autopay method you chose and exactly the down payment amount they give you. Once they confirm that your plan is signed and active, you thank them and end the call.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.monthly_payment_usd: 74.73 = refigure_balance (method, cross encounter): none of his accounts is on a charge-dispute billing hold (the duplicate-supply inquiry is RESOLVED_CREDITED) and reduction 9c51ce18-f8a9-4595-83a3-9cdb66926e76 110.00 was booked 2025-10-09 -> the offer's ledger balance 3,886.00 - 110.00 = 3,776.00; baseline (enrolled total 3,886.00) gives 76.91. deducted_down_share (parameter, cross assist): open case dd3dc30d-94d3-425e-a9f1-ca9436ce1b55 (pending_documents) household_fpl_pct 249.6 above 200 and at most 400, Extended down_payment_pct 10 > 5 -> 5% -> 188.80 deducted, financed 3,587.20; baseline 10% gives 70.8. offer_screening_term (parameter, cross assist): the offer carries term_months 24 = Extended max_term_months 24, FPL 249.6 in (200, 400] and 24 < 48 -> 48; baseline (the offer's 24) gives 149.47. offer_balance_term (parameter): the offer carries the tier's max term, ledger 3,776.00 >= 3,000 (below 10,000) and 24 < 48 -> 48; baseline 24 gives 149.47. offer_floor (parameter, cross assist): FPL 249.6 in (200, 400] and min_monthly_payment_usd 75.00 > 20.00 -> 20.00; baseline 75.00 gives 75.0 (3,587.20 / 48 = 74.73 is below 75.00). plain: term used MN(48, 48) = 48; result MX(20.00, RND(3,587.20 / 48, 2)) = 74.73.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.term_months: 48. Basis: the re-figure rule books the offer 'with that installment and the term used', the term used being the smaller of the offer's screening term (48: the offer carries the Extended maximum 24 and the case FPL 249.6 is above 200 and at most 400) and the offer's balance term (48: ledger 3,776.00 is at least 3,000); the docstring asks for the number of monthly installments the re-figured installment is spread over. The offer floor 20.00 does not apply (3,587.20 / 48 = 74.73 is above it), so the booked term is the term used, not the floor count (the financed amount divided by the floor and rounded up, which would apply only if the floor bound). Uniqueness: both ladders give 48 on this world; 24 (the offer's term) is what each falls to only without the open application or below 3,000, neither of which holds.
